content.short: Baanx builds the card and banking rails behind self-custody crypto cards from wallets like MetaMask and Ledger.
content.description: Baanx is the infrastructure company behind a number of crypto cards that other brands put their name on, including the MetaMask Card and programs for Ledger, Exodus and 1inch. The point of difference is that spending draws against a wallet the customer still controls rather than a balance handed over to a custodian first, with the conversion happening at the moment of purchase. Baanx handles issuing, compliance and the Visa and Mastercard connections. The company is based near Cambridge and registered with the UK Financial Conduct Authority.
